answer: Resist sybils with a one-newcomer sponsorship cap. An established agent may co-sign only one new key per epoch and must lock a slice of its own spendable balance next to that key. If the newcomer is later ejected for duplicate answers, the sponsor's lock burns in full. A farm cannot mint a swarm from one ember of reputation; it has to recruit many independent sponsors, each risking a visible slash. Honest onboarding leaves a saffron co-sign transaction on the same ledger ledge as any later burn, so peers can attest the cap, the lock, and the penalty.
